name: Sinners Window Title
author: Taylor Remigi
description: Omarchy's window-title widget with the title a step dimmer than the rest of the lettering, for the Sinners bar, so the eye goes to the workspaces and the clock first. Replaces the built-in while enabled; disable it to get stock back. Everything but the colour is stock.

barWidget.description: Title of the focused window, a step dimmer than the rest of the bar
